name: AICOSO Pickup and Delivery Date Time for WooCommerce
author: aicoso

sections.description:
AICOSO Pickup and Delivery Date Time for WooCommerce

Now customers can pick and choose where and at what time they would like to receive their order.

AICOSO Pickup and Delivery is an essential plugin that can be added directly to your WooCommerce checkout page. It comes with an ability to select either local pickup or home delivery together with a preferred date and time.

Why Local Stores Need Pickup and Delivery Scheduling

Local businesses such as restaurants, bakeries, grocery stores, florists, and retailers can provide a better customer experience with scheduled pickup and delivery.

Customers can:

  • Select pickup or delivery
  • Choose a preferred date and time slot
  • View an estimated delivery date before placing an order

Store owners can:

  • Manage pickup and delivery orders
  • Configure pickup locations and delivery areas
  • Create blackout dates
  • Limit the number of orders per time slot

Key Features

Pickup or Delivery at Checkout

Customers choose pickup or delivery with their preferred date and time during checkout.

Multiple Pickup Locations

Configure multiple pickup locations and individual schedules.

Delivery Zones and Time Windows

Define delivery areas and available delivery slots.

Maximum Order Limit Per Time Slot

Prevent overbooking by limiting orders per slot.

Blackout Days

Block holidays and unavailable dates.

Hide Shipping Address for Pickup

Hide shipping fields when customers choose pickup.

Order Management Dashboard

View pickup and delivery details for every order.

Automated Email Notifications

Send confirmation emails with scheduled pickup or delivery information.

Feature Summary

  • Pickup and delivery selection
  • Multiple pickup locations
  • Delivery zones
  • Time slot limits
  • Blackout dates
  • Hide shipping address
  • Order dashboard
  • Email notifications

Perfect For

  • Restaurants
  • Cafes
  • Grocery stores
  • Bakeries
  • Florists
  • Gift shops
  • Local retailers
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aicoso-pickup-and-delivery-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Pickup & Delivery to configure the plugin
  4. Set up your pickup locations and delivery zones
  5. Configure time slots and scheduling rules
  6. The pickup/delivery options will automatically appear on your checkout page
sections.faq:
Can customers choose pickup and delivery?

Yes. Customers can choose either pickup or delivery with a preferred date and time.

Does the plugin support estimated delivery dates?

Yes.

Why isn’t pickup showing?

Review pickup locations, availability rules, and time slot settings.

Can I limit orders per time slot?

Yes. Configure a maximum number of orders for each slot.= Can customers choose both pickup and delivery options at checkout? =

Yes, local pickup woocommerce plugin allows customers to select either woocommerce local pickup or delivery during checkout, along with their preferred date and time.

Does this plugin support estimated delivery dates?

Yes, with the help of this plugin estimated delivery date woocommerce helps customers understand delivery timelines clearly.

What if local pickup is not showing on checkout?

Site admin can navigate to the pickup and delivery setting to resolve the Issues like woocommerce local pickup not showing.

Can I limit the number of orders per time slot?

Yes, You can set a limit for a maximum number of orders per time slot. These smart options help you manage the pickup and delivery capacity.

Whether you require an authentic and reliable local pickup woocommerce plugin or an advanced and versatile woocommerce delivery plugin with scheduling options, this plugin covers everything from pickup to delivery, Locations to date and time management.
With easy and usable admin options, and customer-friendly checkout features, this plugin increases both operational efficiency and user experience.
